pin_regs.reason: a relay standard is ONE register stage pin to pin (a -> flop -> b, no logic): its data flop is the pin register of both pins (io_flop_at_pins anchors it at the faces); the die plan counts exactly 1 core cycle per relay stage (kv_die.py relay_stages), so extra pin registers would change the static calendar

job.purpose: Qwen KV/system die relay STANDARD qkd_rlys_36: one register stage of width class 36 b (a W face in, b E face out, ck S), 12.96 x 12.96 um, M5 cap, W/E pins on M4 at 3 tracks (<= 4.17 pins/um, rule <= 8 pins/um/layer, VIS-ROM QKV-04), no reset (flush rule), 1 cycle/stage as the die plan; replaces the 21 generated qkd_rly_<W> masters as replicas (tools/qwen_kv_die/kv_rly_std.py, OT_KV_RLY_STD=1)
